mapper.select: SELECT info_id, event_place, address, play_time, use_time, sponsor1, sponsor1_tel, sponsor2, sponsor2_tel, contact_tel, homepage_url, source_type, external_content_id, created_at, updated_at FROM festival_info WHERE info_id = #{infoId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO festival_info ( info_id, event_place, address, play_time, use_time, sponsor1, sponsor1_tel, sponsor2, sponsor2_tel, contact_tel, homepage_url, source_type, external_content_id ) VALUES ( #{infoId}, #{eventPlace}, #{address}, #{playTime}, #{useTime}, #{sponsor1}, #{sponsor1Tel}, #{sponsor2}, #{sponsor2Tel}, #{contactTel}, #{homepageUrl}, COALESCE(#{sourceType}, 'ADMIN'), #{externalContentId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE festival_info SET event_place = #{eventPlace}, address = #{address}, play_time = #{playTime}, use_time = #{useTime}, sponsor1 = #{sponsor1}, sponsor1_tel = #{sponsor1Tel}, sponsor2 = #{sponsor2}, sponsor2_tel = #{sponsor2Tel}, contact_tel = #{contactTel}, homepage_url = #{homepageUrl}, source_type = COALESCE(#{sourceType}, 'ADMIN'), external_content_id = #{externalContentId} WHERE info_id = #{infoId}
